g.text: The three states of a thread
input, disk, a child, a timer
scheduled: a CPU is free, and this thread is picked
preempted: time slice over, a higher-priority thread woke up, or it yielded
RUNNING: at most one thread per CPU
READY: any number, queued up for a CPU
BLOCKED: any number, each in the wait queue of its event
ps shows R for ready or running,
S for blocked (sleeping), D for blocked on I/O
A thread is always in exactly one of the three. Most threads, most of the time, are blocked: that is why 4,614 threads fit on 24 CPUs.
